findings.issue: Spec states '22 tests (16 in default store suite + 1 in AC-6 lock-expiry + other)' but actual vitest run reports 18/18 (17 in default store suite + 1 in AC-6 suite). The count '22' is stale from an earlier draft. No functional impact — all tests pass.
findings.suggestion: Update spec test count to 18 in a future cleanup pass. Non-blocking.

findings.issue: When both an explicit non-null store and storeMode='memory' are passed to createServer, the explicit store is used as-is (potentially a PostgresJobStore) while timerStore and outboxStore are forced to undefined. Asymmetry is documented in JSDoc but can surprise future callers expecting full memory isolation. No current call site hits this case.
findings.suggestion: Add a JSDoc warning or runtime assertion in a future cleanup. Not blocking.
